hooks.command: FILE="$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path')"; case "$FILE" in *.rs) cargo.exe check -p sim ;; esac
FILE="$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path')"; case "$FILE" in *.rs) cargo.exe clippy --all-targets ;; esac
FILE="$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path')"; case "$FILE" in *.rs) cargo.exe test ;; esac
FILE="$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path')"; case "$FILE" in *.cs) dotnet.exe build client/skock.csproj ;; esac
FILE="$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path')"; case "$FILE" in *.cs) dotnet.exe test client.tests/skock.tests.csproj ;; esac
FILE="$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path')"; case "$FILE" in *.cs) roslynator.exe analyze client/skock.csproj ;; esac
